title: Inspect and extend: Debug one event from finger to cursor
objective: Use the real implementation in `server/relay.js` to demonstrate and safely improve end-to-end protocol path, fallback logging, and evidence from isolated tests.
problem: Trace one dx/dy event from a gesture through WebSocket framing to the relay mapping. Tests inject fake robot/socket objects, so they validate logic without moving a real cursor. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `server/relay.js` and the related project files: src/data.ts; src/connection.ts; server/index.js; server/relay.js; server/test/relay.test.js.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to end-to-end protocol path, fallback logging, and evidence from isolated tests.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: The test suite does not prove the phone and host can reach each other on a real network.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: Trace one dx/dy event from a gesture through WebSocket framing to the relay mapping. Tests inject fake robot/socket objects, so they validate logic without moving a real cursor.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `server/relay.js`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
